newsitem.title: USA: ANTEC in talks with TSX.
newsitem.headline: ANTEC in talks with TSX.

text.p: ANTEC Corp said Wednesday it and TSX Corp are discussing a combination of their companies.
The transaction would involve conversion of each share of TSX common stock into 1.05 shares of ANTEC common.
The combination would require approval of each company's board of directors and stockholders.
ANTEC said the transaction would be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

ANTEC is an international communications technology company specializing in the design and engineering of broadband networks and the manufacturing, materials management and supply of products for fiber and coaxial broadband networks.
El Paso, Texas-based TSX manufactures CATV fiber optic and radio frequency distribution electronics.
